name: Power profiler (Nordic Power Profiler Kit II)
description: Nordic's Power Profiler Kit II, which follows a board's current as it runs: as a source meter it powers the board (0.8 to 5.0 V, at most 600 mA), as an ampere meter it sits in series with the board's own supply (up to 1 A). It samples the current at 100 kS/s from 200 nA to 1 A, switching between its five ranges by itself, with D0 to D7 of its logic port sampled alongside; the workbench shows it as Nordic's Power Profiler app does.

pins.name: VIN
pins.doc: Ampere meter mode: the board's own supply in (the PPK2's VIN)

pins.name: VOUT
pins.doc: To the board's supply (the PPK2's VOUT)

pins.name: GND
pins.doc: Ground, to the board's ground (also in ampere meter mode)

pins.name: VCC
pins.doc: Logic port VCC: the board's logic supply (1.65 to 5.5 V)

mode.doc: Source meter (it powers the board from VOUT) or ampere meter (in series, VIN to VOUT)

voltage.doc: Source meter mode: the voltage at VOUT

r_out.doc: Source meter mode: the output's resistance below its current limit (an assumption)

r_series.doc: Ampere meter mode: the resistance in series, VIN to VOUT (not published: an assumption)

logic_vil.doc: Logic port: low below this (an assumption: 0.3 of a 3.3 V VCC)

logic_vih.doc: Logic port: high above this (an assumption: 0.7 of a 3.3 V VCC)

omissions: the measurement resistors' values and the voltage they drop (not published: r_series is an assumption)
the accuracy as an error (+-10 %, +-15 % in the top range): readings are exact to their resolution
the transients when the range switches
sinking current in source meter mode
the inputs' thresholds and impedance (not published: VIL and VIH are assumptions, 0.3 and 0.7 of a 3.3 V VCC by default)
the 50 kHz bandwidth as a filter: a pulse shorter than a sample may still be seen if a sample falls in it

electrical.claims: Its measurement core (emblink/ppk2_core) and logic port (emblink/ppk2_logic_port): a source meter or ampere meter sampling the current into the board at 100 kS/s at its range's resolution, D0 to D7 at 100 kHz.
omissions: the measurement resistors' values and the voltage they drop (not published: r_series is an assumption)
the accuracy as an error (+-10 %, +-15 % in the top range): readings are exact to their resolution
the transients when the range switches
sinking current in source meter mode
the inputs' thresholds and impedance (not published: VIL and VIH are assumptions, 0.3 and 0.7 of a 3.3 V VCC by default)
the 50 kHz bandwidth as a filter: a pulse shorter than a sample may still be seen if a sample falls in it

sources.title: Nordic Semiconductor, Power Profiler Kit II User Guide v1.0.1 (4461_012), section 8: source meter 0.8-5.0 V at most 600 mA; ampere meter 1 A continuous; resolution 200 nA-50 uA 0.2 uA, 50-500 uA 0.5 uA, 0.5-5 mA 5 uA, 5-50 mA 50 uA, 50-1000 mA 1000 uA; accuracy +-10 % (+-15 % in the top range); 100 kS/s; logic port D0-D7 with VCC 1.65-5.5 V, sampled at 100 kHz; it cannot measure negative currents
